blocks.content: The Search Committee prepares a panel of candidates. It must include individuals with expertise in law, vigilance, finance, anti-corruption policy, public administration, and governance.
The Search Committee prepares a panel of candidates.

items: Questions frequently focus on the mandatory qualifications and expertise areas required for members of the Search Committee.
Remember that the primary responsibility of the Search Committee is panel preparation, not final candidate appointment.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The primary mandate of the Search Committee is to prepare a curated panel of suitable candidates.
Committee members must possess demonstrated expertise in specific legal, administrative, and financial fields.
Mandatory fields of expertise include law, vigilance, finance, anti-corruption policy, public administration, and governance.
